notes.title: Some news about the future
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I think it's important to clarify a few things about "The Architect: Paris" and its future. Let's start by taking a quick look at its history.

TAP is a game developed by ENODO GAMES that was released on STEAM as an early access game in February 2021. The full version of the game was released in September 2021. Unfortunately, ENODO GAMES had to file for bankruptcy in early 2022.

After many months of negotiations and administrative discussions, we managed to find a buyer for ENODO GAMES' activities and intellectual property. This enabled us to save and transfer some of the team's employees to a new company called 5PM STUDIO.

This company now owns the rights to "The Architect: Paris".

This team had already been working for several months on a new concept called "Bergerac", which appealed to the new investors. When it came to deciding whether the team should continue its work on TAP or develop this new project, we had to take into account a large number of parameters, both technical and marketing.

It was a difficult decision to make, and to be totally transparent, the fact that we were moving on to something else played a big part in the balance. By mutual agreement between the members of the team and the investors, we decided to work on this new project, which is now called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228280/MEMORIAPOLIS/]Mémoriapolis[/url].

We're still aiming to develop TAP further, and we're already thinking about possible future developments. But I can't tell you when we'll resume development.

I admit my mistakes: I didn't communicate enough with TAP players about the future of the game. Although there are a number of reasons for this lack of communication, I apologise for this.

Jean-Baptiste
Game Director

notes.notes:
[h1]Meet our new Architect of the Week[/h1]
[i]We're getting closer to the release date of TA:P, can't wait?[/i]

In the meantime, it's election day for our new Architect of the Week. And this week it's a bit special, since it's a beta tester that we congratulate, cheers to [b]K4Y4K[/b]!
Although he uses very different designs, the creations on these blocks are very harmonious. He was able to make very nice blocks with the constraints imposed.
And it gives you a preview of what's to come...

He was able to test the game in Beta-test and try the proposed content, so you can't use these creations within your own city, for the moment.

Meet us here next Friday to find out who will win the next Architect of the Week title!
Don't forget to share your creations on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/qfk4zRbJfU]Discord community[/url].

See you next week ♥

[b]LISE[/b]
Hey! 

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
Hello!

[b]LISE[/b]
So we're pretty curious about the thoughts you had to go through to create this project, how you went about it and if the game gave you any trouble.
Are you an architecture student or an architect?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
In real life I'm just a postman. I always loved city builders, Architecture & Design, because of that I really like Architect Paris.

[b]LISE[/b]
When you create your buildings, are you inspired by existing buildings? And do you try to keep a trace of the original, or do you go in a completely different direction?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
Mostly I try to save some old buildings or recreate them. I use satellite photos, google maps or something similar to take a look at the original layout and try to improve it a little bit. So yes!
First I tried to create a more accurate Elysee Palace, but the limitations of designs prompted me to make it different, more modern.

[b]LISE[/b]
So, do you first make a sketch on paper, or do you first make drafts in the game before arriving at the result you want?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
I try to recreate it directly ingame. It's a lot of try and error, the tools are good, but not as precise as wanted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774867/d13bb03d652934edb1b44a3d9ab296b111733a91.jpg[/img]

[b]LISE[/b]
And how many attempts do you make to get a result that you like in general?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
Often I redraw the layout of a building 2-3 times, mostly because of difficulties with the roof creation.

[b]LISE[/b]
I would have liked to know what tools you could miss, or what improvements could be made to the tools to make them more precise or easier to use?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
It would be very usefull if I could directly call the game which angles I need, and it’s kinda annoying that layouts that are no longer connected to the rest can't be used any more.

[b]LISE[/b]
We were talking about building styles earlier, and I was wondering, do you prefer to stay in a traditional style then? Or do you sometimes do a little bit more special design, like futuristic or medieval?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
I really like traditional styles. I think Paris has to look like Paris, even with modern additions. I would like to have some more styles, so I love every new Style in the workshop.

[b]LISE[/b]
Are we likely to see projects with a different style then ?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
There are some styles I don't use, like cyclades (the greek one), but I definitely will use a lot of different styles in future projects.

[b]LISE[/b]
You told me that you did everything with the drawing board, but for the choice of building designs, do you already know beforehand which ones you want to use or do you experiment with several different designs?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
It depends on what I want to build, a palais or theatre should have a more classical design but a shopping mall can be very modern looking. So, I often experiment with several designs and how they work together.

[b]LISE[/b]
How did you choose the block you were going to build it on? Did you want a particular block, or did you choose by size?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
Mostly I just choose a block nearby other blocks I've already transformed.

[b]LISE[/b]
Was the choice of the base district made according to certain criteria or not at all?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
Mostly, not at all, for my project that won Architect of the Week I wanted to use the size of the plot. I was inspired by the work of TomKop11 the week before and wanted to make something similar, but connected to my version of the Elysee Palace.

[b]LISE[/b]
Do you adapt to the block you use in general?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
Yes, mostly!

[b]LISE[/b]
When you make a project, you impose yourself on certain objectives, from what I understand you want to give them a modern side, but do you have other criteria that you impose yourself when you create?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
I use the original layout and try to improve it, to make them more accurate, add something new and keep it realistic. I don't like to add a giant skyscraper that doesn't fit and I always try to think about what people need. Especially Light, Space, some Nature, Plazas and off course a parking space, I add a lot of parking garages, to make the district more realistic.

[b]LISE[/b]
In [i]The Architect: Paris[/i], what is the feature you like the most?
Also, if you could add a feature not currently in the game, what would it be?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
I really like the Plot Editor and that you can create one Building out of different parts & styles, you can create very detailed backyards. I love all these little Details, a small Park, a secret path or something else.
A feature that's not currently in game, but definitely needed is a tool to place single plops, like single trees or bushes, a single line of trees in front of the building, some street lights or tables.

[b]LISE[/b]
Do you have any idea of the next project you will do on the game?

[b]PSCHRAEER[/b]
currently I'm working on a hospital complex on D.30-B.40

[b]LISE[/b]
Can’t wait to see it!

notes.title: What's New in April ?
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ZzGQwE7PY10;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

[i]The past two months were rich in terms of content with several additional features.
But what are these new features that have been implemented? Let's check this out![/i]

Let's talk about March a little bit, we added [b]3 new districts[/b], so you can walk around the [i]Arc de Triomphe[/i] for example, and these districts did not arrive alone, but with [b]several new designs[/b] for your buildings. 

We wanted to make parks and plazas more alive and make them one with the rest of your constructions. You can now add play areas, picnic areas and many more with [b]the Terrain tool[/b]. 
It's not just plazas and parks that have the right to be more alive, with [b]the addition of VFX[/b] on your buildings.

You can now modify more things on your buildings, with [b]the addition of several options[/b], including the possibility of activating or deactivating blind facades, objects on the roofs or even store fronts.
And if you have designs that you use a lot of good news, [b]adding a Recent category[/b] makes it easy for you to find them.

But what about April? 

First of all, we have set up [b]the Photo Mode[/b], it will allow you to roam freely in your [i]Paris[/i] to take the best pictures.
You can manage the position, the angle of the camera but also the focus, and this, in a completely free way.

Something that should please you, we have expanded again your playground with [b]3 new districts[/b] again, as well as the addition of several designs. 
But also [b]new 4 languages are appearing[/b] in the game [i]Spanish | Italian | Pусский | 中文[/i], be aware that the Russian translation is 100%. 
Thanks to dedicated players !  

Last but not least, [b]welcome to Modding[/b] ! You will be able to create and share your models, as well as import models from other players of [i]The Architect : Paris[/i]. 
Come here to discover the modding world in our game : [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/18446744073709551615/3126038156537546211/?appid=1525620]Modding Tool Guide (Steam)[/url]
We added [b]two more sandbox modes[/b] with a no man's land [i]Paris[/i], with just a vacant lot, and a Vanilla Paris which was the older version. 

And for our players who don't have big machines in terms of computers. We have what you need. Now, you can hide districts, that's allows you to reduce your CPU/GPU load when several districts are playable.

[u]Link to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1525620/discussions/0/3108018050522967956/?snr=2_9_100003_]Patch Notes Feed here[/url]![/u]

We will meet at the end of the week to elect our architect of the week !

notes.title: Answers to your feedbacks
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
First of all, we want to [u][b]thank every player[/b][/u] who made feedbacks & reports, we read every one of them and it will help us to make the game better.

We have written a document that lists all of them, and we decided to respond here to let you know what we are working on and what we want to do on our next steps.

Hope you’ll find your answers to your questions/requests.

[h2][b]GENERAL[/b][/h2]

[i]Q: Will we have more plaza/parks in the future? Will we be able to customize them?[/i]
A: At the moment, we’ve got 3 parks and 3 plazas in the game, but yes, we want you to be able to customize them, and we will make it happen in 2 steps: first, we’ll add some new presets (starting this month) and second, we wish to provide a full customization tool (assets, textures, etc.) but we need much more time and testing to do it.

[i]Q: Will we be able to have a free camera to look over the entire city and cruise or fly between our skyscrapers? Could we change the camera angle?[/i]
A: This Camera angle is used for the right optimization of our city rendering system. However, we have a new feature which will be released in April called Photo Mode. It’ll let you control the camera as you wish. But be careful, it’s possible that you could have some minor constraints like the impossibility to go under the bridges and also maybe some holes in building modelized could be visible.

[i]Q: TAP displays lots of helpers to guide the player, but sometimes it’s hard to understand what we need to do.[/i]
A: As we read your feedback, we saw several players blocked by our first helper pop-up, so we decided to add the Esc key as a second input to help you to exit the “Helper Mode”. We also saw that some shortcuts can be in conflict with our controls, so some changes are coming (for example another shortcut for the selection display than the Alt key).

[i]Q: The graphic settings are unclear, and we can’t find our monitor’s native resolution [/i]
We are currently only supporting 16/9 resolutions and our graphic settings might lack explanations, so it’s intended to add more resolutions (the next ratio supported will probably be 21/9) and more help for the settings during the Early Access (like tooltips, sounds balancing, etc.).

[i]Q: Are you planning to add an auto-save system?[/i]
A: As we read your feedback and watch your streams, many of you asked for an auto-save system. At this time, our team is working on globally improving the save/load system and in the end it should give an auto-saving system. It's a wish we've had for some time. 
However, to be sure to have a strong and reliable system, we need to break the saves compatibility for the patch of the end of March. All saved games would be impossible to load.

[i]Q: Will TAP be a Simulation game with management features and so on?[/i]
A: Like we said earlier many times, we tried to include those features, but the result was unfunny, unclear, and players were frustrated. Among those we tried, the most successful idea was to create some goals to achieve in Paris, winning assets, designs, customization tools, and letting you unlock the playable city district per district. Starting with this idea and our past tries, we’re currently working on something that could be interesting for you. We will let you know soon the result.

[h2][b]STRATEGIC MAP[/b][/h2]

[i]Q: Can we start without any building built in Paris?[/i]
A: It’s an interesting idea we didn’t think about until now. We’ll see if it’s possible in the Sandbox Mode.

[h2][b]CITY VIEW[/b][/h2]

[i]Q: In your Roadmap, there is a feature called “Life Simulation”, what is it?[/i]
A: Life Simulation is an improvement of the liveliness of the city. We want to add more pedestrians in parks / Landmarks, birds, drones, add fountains, chimney smoke, etc. Lots of small details that will make the city more lively. We’ll try to add some life and assets all along our Early Access.

[i]Q: The buildings near the camera are blurry.[/i]
A: The Depth of Field settings for each Time Of Day has been tweaked for the upcoming march’s patch. If you’re annoyed by this, you already have the possibility to enable/disable the Depth of Field in the Graphic Settings for each environment.

[i]Q: If I’m not interested in building the Main Projects, am I able to modify the same block with the Drawing Board?[/i]
A: If the Main Project is not also a Landmark, it is possible to modify the block without building those (entering the Drawing Board is still possible). With our Modding / Sharing system (which is coming in the end of April), if you want to create another big building instead of our own propositions, you’ll be able to do that and share it via the Steam’s Workshop!

[i]Q: The entire map seems very big, have you thought about a compass or Street marks (street’s name, etc)?[/i]
A: We already thought about adding a compass in the City View, it’ll surely come sometime during the Early Access.

[h2][b]DRAWING BOARD[/b][/h2]

[i]Q: Do you plan to add more customization in the game? Like customize roads?[/i]
A: Our top priority is to be able to fully customize buildings, parks and plazas in the first place. If you still want to push the game in that way, we’ll think about it and see what it could be done to bring more customizations to the game, like vehicle diversity, more settings, more shops on ground-floors, more visual impacts of your actions, etc. For now, our next steps are:
[list]
[*]Add a new big feature called Customizer
[list]
[*]Will be allowed to customize Paris buildings and blocks on a larger and smaller scale
[*]Add different floor from different Design in a same plot
[*]Possibility to change the shape of the building
[/list]
[*]Add modding/sharing features for our community
[*]Add more settings for personalize Paris rendering
[list]
[*]Add a button to enable/disable the Blind Facade
[*]Add a button to enable/disable props on roof
[*]Assets on Roof: aligned with the big facade
[/list]
[/list]

[i]Q: Some building floors seem to have a different height. Why? Is it a bug? Will you uniformize them?[/i]
A: No, it’s not a bug! Each Design has its own height, identity,  place, shape. We wanted to create Designs that are unique from each other. In order to guide you a bit more, we’ll add their height in the Design Library in the upcoming March’s patch.

[i]Q: At the moment we can’t tweak back our own designs after we submitted our project. Will we be able to do it?[/i]
A: Yes, we’ll add this possibility with the March’s patch. 

[i]Q: After hours and hours in the Drawing Board, I customized a lot my designs, but it’ll be awesome to have something to save my presets, or, to copy/paste my settings from one to another.[/i]
A: That’s something we wanted for a long time. We’re working on it right now, we wanted first to think about the right way to do it from a player’s point of view.

[i]Q: It could be great to see the adjacent blocks if we want to make some good perspective through a few blocks?[/i]
A: It’s an idea we wish to do, but it requires an enormous amount of our dev time. We need to define what we want and how we can do it. But be sure that we’ll think about it seriously.

[h2][b]PLOT EDITOR[/b][/h2]

[i]Q: In the Plot Editor, angles can’t be under 60°, which makes it difficult sometimes to create an original shape of our Designs.[/i]
A: At first, we decided to make impossible angles under 60° for technical issues, many holes in designs would appear, texturing would be inconsistent, etc. We thought that if we let the players make an unrealistic angle (like, 12°) it’ll downgrade their experience, so we didn’t allow it. However, we continue to think about it as several players said it’ll be interesting to have fewer constraints, the counterpart would be to accept some of those technical issues.

[i]Q: Will we have new tools in the Plot Editor to let us make copy/paste our plots, or assist us to make identical/symmetrical draws?[/i]
A: Making shapes and holes in the Plot Editor isn’t the exact philosophy of the tool we thought. Yet, we agree that this tool need more tips and helps to guide you.

[h2][b]MISC / OTHERS[/b][/h2]

[i]Q: Could it be possible to see the Roadmap of TAP somewhere? Is it set in stone?[/i]
A: In the first place, the Roadmap was a good way for you to see where the game wants to go further and what’s in the next updates. It’s possible to switch or replace some features with another, but it’ll take time to produce and develop them. Actually it’ll depend on you, of what you want to see in The Architect: Paris and what we can do. As requested, we’ll post the Roadmap with deeper explanations about our updates on our Social Medias. It’ll also update on the game every month.

------------------------------------------------------------------

We hope we have answered all of your questions and feedback. Our main goal remains to improve The Architect: Paris both from a technical/stability and gameplay point of view, therefore helping you to discover Paris step by step.

Thank you for you reading. Oh, and one more thing....Our next update will come 29 March 2021.

Stay tuned!
